title: ChatGPT pioneer launches Jev model for programmatic logic
summary: TypeSafe AI, founded by a ChatGPT co-inventor, emerged from stealth to launch Jev—a specialized System One Model designed for programmatic logic and automated deterministic decisions. Unlike conversational LLMs, Jev uses a parallel sampling architecture to execute structured probabilistic decisions directly within production environments.
problem_solved: Enables software systems requiring automated, deterministic logic to bypass traditional conversational language models for more efficient production-grade decision-making.
why_valuable: Provides specialized AI inference for programmatic use cases with better performance and direct production integration compared to general-purpose LLMs.
